body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 5 units. On a success, it cannot benefit from Concentration, Rallied, or a Stance until the start of its next turn.

surges.html: On a success, make the target Exposed.
Ignore line of sight for one target you can otherwise locate within this card's range.

rider.title: FRACTURE — STRAIN
rider.html: If you gained Strain while resolving this Action, the target also cannot gain or consume a Specialty Condition until the start of its next turn.
